episodes.153401: As an upper trough moved over the state from west to east; a moist trade wind flow added fuel that ignited heavy showers, isolated thunderstorms, and flash flooding. The heavy rain mainly produced small stream and drainage ditch flooding, and ponding on roadways. The flash flooding, however, closed Kuhio Highway near the Hanalei Bridge for much of the day on Kauai. There were no reports of serious injuries or property damage.
episodes.153449: A line of showers and thunderstorms developed during the evening hours ahead of a low  pressure system moving through the Ohio Valley.
episodes.153997: An isolated storm produced marginally severe hail and wind in the Enterprise area.
episodes.153998: A marginally severe storm moved through Early county ahead of a cold front.
episodes.154387: Heavy bands of rain moved along a slow moving cold front on the morning of the 26th. These bands produced locally heavy rainfall across portions of the central Midlands. Rainfall amounts of 1 to 1.5 inches fell in a 1 to 2 hour period across downtown Columbia. This produced rapid rises along many of the area creeks including Rocky Branch.

events.narrative: A few trees were downed on the south side of Eaton.

City of Columbia Police reported the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street flooded. Areas along Rocky Branch were flooded from the intersection of Blossom Street and Pickens Street. This also includes areas along Maxcy Gregg Park. The USGS stream gage at the intersection of Whaley Street and Main Street crested at 8.6 feet. Flood stage is 7.2 feet.
A tree was blown down along with pea sized hail reported.
The public reported nickel sized hail in the Enterprise area via social media.
The Enterprise police reported a telephone wire blown down along with estimated wind gusts of 60 mph.
The public reported nickel to quarter sized hail near Enterprise via social media.
